sources.title: Pine Script v6: Repainting
sources.key_findings: Offset HTF expressions within request.security and use lookahead_on to obtain completed HTF values consistently.
sources.limitations: Reference pattern is not a guarantee against all logic errors, feed revisions or dataset-start effects.
sources.access_reviewed: Relevant HTF and confirmed-bar sections consulted.

sources.title: Pine Script v6: Alerts
sources.key_findings: Alert conditions and detailed alerts can use closed-bar conditions; server alerts snapshot script settings.
sources.limitations: Alerts are notifications, not fill evidence.

sources.title: LibraryCOT
sources.market_dataset: TradingView COT symbols and report categories
sources.methodology: Generate supported ticker IDs for request.security.
sources.key_findings: A supported COT data-access route exists; arbitrary Python CSV imports are not needed or implied.
sources.limitations: Symbol access, category mapping, actual release timing and revisions need verification before a causal historical filter.
sources.hypothesis: Future optional weekly context, not intraday institution detection.
sources.access_reviewed: Public library overview consulted; no imported version or historical release audit performed.

sources.title: Pine Script v6: Other timeframes and data
sources.key_findings: Supports security and selected specialized feeds, including footprint data where available; not arbitrary local Python dataset access.
sources.limitations: Capabilities depend on feed/account/context. OHLCV alone is not an event-level book and does not provide historical broker execution costs.
sources.hypothesis: Use chart/HTF OHLCV now; verify specialist feeds separately.
sources.access_reviewed: Request signatures and supported-source overview consulted.

sources.title: Volume Profile indicators: basic concepts
sources.market_dataset: Platform volume profile calculations using lower-timeframe data where available
sources.methodology: Price-level volume histogram and point-of-control/value-area definitions.
sources.key_findings: Volume profile uses volume by price; forex/CFD products may use tick volume. Platform profiles use lower-timeframe bars rather than a uniform allocation through a single candle range.
sources.limitations: A candle-range allocation proxy cannot reproduce the platform profile or the within-bar traded-price distribution; chart-feed volume is not necessarily centralized trade volume.
sources.hypothesis: POC/value-area location is descriptive context only until a predeclared gold-specific test is completed.
sources.access_reviewed: Public Help Center methodology, inputs and POC/value-area descriptions consulted.

sources.title: Pine Script v6: Sessions
sources.methodology: Pine language/API reference for time-based and named sessions.
sources.key_findings: Pine exposes symbol session state and custom session checks; session.ismarket depends on the symbol's session definition.
sources.limitations: A session flag is not an exchange calendar, broker connection monitor, or direct liquidity measure.
sources.hypothesis: Use feed session state as an explicit signal gate; verify behavior on each selected gold feed.
sources.access_reviewed: Public session-state and time-based session documentation consulted.
